name: Micora
long_description:
Micora builds a solar-farm-in-a-box that can be shipped anywhere and built without specialized labor. We have designed a new type of solar farm micorgrid that is palletized, lightweight, and deployable. Our system autonomously builds 100kWp of capacity per day and is easily scalable to MWs of capacity which is a size currently only serviced by slow moving and at capacity EPCs. 

As demand from data centers, advanced manufacturing, and electrification strains existing power infrastructure, the ability to deploy substantial generation quickly is becoming increasingly valuable and unavailable. We are the only company that services utility-scale power needs in weeks.
one_liner: Microgrids in a box built anywhere in days

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Design, manufactured, and shipped heat pumps as CTO of Normal Robotics, published a few papers on multi-agent robotics and, worked on autonomous space robotics missions with NASA JPL / Astrobotic.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Fredy is a co-founder of Micora. Previously, he worked in J.P. Morgan’s Healthcare Investment Banking group and was a founding team member at Pear Suite, an AI-enabled platform and provider network for community health workers (CHWs).
